content: The CoverageOptimizerPanel is a React component that provides a UI for coverage optimization. It accepts project, primaryPano, and onSetCaptureOrigin props. The component tracks optimization mode (default 'fixed-first'), status ('idle' | 'running' | 'complete' | 'failed'), and result state. It calculates captureOrigin from primaryPano or project.scene.panoOrigin, and derives floorRegion bounds from captureOrigin and cameraHeight. The analyze function extracts scene geometry via extractCoverageScene and runs coverage optimization, supporting cancellation and progress tracking.

items.text: CoverageOptimizerPanel component interface: accepts project: LocationProject, primaryPano?: PanoReference, onSetCaptureOrigin?: (origin: Vec3) => void

items.text: cameraHeight defaults to 1.6m from project.settings.defaultCameraHeightMeters; captureOrigin derived from primaryPano.origin or project.scene.panoOrigin
Default floorRegion bounds: min=[captureOrigin[0]-5, captureOrigin[1]-cameraHeight-0.25, captureOrigin[2]-5], max=[captureOrigin[0]+5, captureOrigin[1]-cameraHeight+0.25, captureOrigin[2]+5]
analyze function cancels previous task before starting new analysis
extractCoverageScene called with project, progress callback, and optional floorRegion constraint when restrictFloorRegion is enabled
